summary: This August 2025 lecture is already a public backbone source for Eschatology: it defines end-times stories as geopolitical scripts, then routes that mechanism into hybrid war, secret coordination, Iran pressure, gerontocratic time horizon, and a dated 10-20 year forecast family.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Eschatology supplies scripts, roles, unconscious coordination, and fanatic energy.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source directly carries the public Eschatology definition and should remain the core anchor for eschatology as an action-coordinating script rather than generic religious belief.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Moscow as Third Rome and Dugin's Eurasian strategy turn Orthodox prophecy into a strategic map.
existing_lens_links.rationale: This is not a standalone Dugin page from this source; it is the public example of prophecy becoming geopolitical planning.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Hybrid war attacks legitimacy, basic services, and the population-state bond before visible battlefield defeat.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Strategy owns the material test when invisible pressure must still be judged by whether a population breaks, hardens, or gives the state permission to escalate.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Sabotage against Iran can harden resolve, make Hormuz closure usable, and force the no-exit ground war.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Iran As Pressure Point owns the country-specific pressure-and-backfire mechanism; Eschatology owns the wider role-script layer.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Eschatology gives secret power cooperation, deniability, and coordination that explicit conspiracies struggle to maintain.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Secret Society owns the coordination-technology comparison only when the active mechanism is hidden cooperation; Eschatology owns the script itself.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The Anglo-American empire fails to counterstrategy because aging controllers expect to be dead before the consequences arrive.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Gerontocracy owns the time-horizon failure; the eschatological forecast supplies the hostile map that the old rulers decline to answer.

concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns the sacred script and role assignment. Game Theory owns payoff/player analysis only when the mechanism is explicit incentive logic rather than sacred story coordination.

concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns the material audit of hybrid pressure because the outcome depends on whether the state's population bond breaks or hardens. Eschatology owns the role-map that may make the same suffering meaningful.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the clean bridge from explicit conspiracy to unconscious coordination, where shared eschatological scripts can align actors without a fragile command chain.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Secret Society should not absorb the full religious script taxonomy; it uses this source only for coordination technology, secrecy, deniability, and cooperation.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: preserve the closing baby-boomer passage as a geopolitical time-horizon failure, where old controllers do not answer a visible hostile plan because the bill arrives after their expected deaths.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Gerontocracy owns shortened imperial time horizon. Prediction owns later scoring of the 10-20 year sequence, and Eschatology owns the hostile role-script map.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold this source for a future forecast-family comparison of the dated 10-20 year scenario: Iran invasion, Odessa/NATO stalemate, Turkey/Byzantium, Israel/Third Temple, Putin succession, China absence, and Anglo-American retreat should be split into testable subclaims rather than promoted as one apocalypse forecast.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns source date, horizon, conditions, and later comparison. Eschatology owns why actors might move toward the same crisis even when their theologies contradict.

new_lens_seeds.title: Eschatological Convergence Points
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Incompatible sacred scripts can still move rival actors toward the same crisis site when each tradition maps its own end-times role onto the same objects: Israel, Iran, the Dome of the Rock, Turkey, Russia, Europe, America, China, and world war.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism could help route future Middle East, Third Temple, Gog and Magog, Pax Judaica, Antichrist, and holy-war material, but current public Eschatology can carry it without a child page.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a routing seed. The Eschatology page was recently judged whole enough to carry convergence without creating standalone Holy Empire, AI God, Pax Judaica, Al-Aqsa Sequence, Antichrist, or Gog And Magog pages.

new_lens_seeds.title: Prophecy As Geostrategy
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A sacred destiny becomes a geopolitical plan when a thinker translates the role-script into alliances, enemy maps, transport geography, chokepoints, and succession assumptions.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The Dugin/Moscow example is strong, but public Eschatology already has a durable anchor for prophecy becoming geopolitical plan.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create standalone Dugin, Third Rome, Katechon, Eurasia, Byzantium, or prophecy-as-strategy pages from this source alone.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-08-01, this is the public core source for the Eschatology family and glossary definition; later AI-God, Pax Judaica, Iran-war, and Holy Empire materials should be compared against this formulation rather than treated as origins.

The 10-20 year scenario is a dated forecast family, not a single ledger item: Iran/Hormuz escalation, Odessa/NATO, Turkey/Byzantium, Israel/Third Temple, Islamic revolutions, Putin succession, China absence, and Anglo-American retreat have different objects and test paths.

The Catholic-power and U.S. civil-war passages are explicitly speculative and sometimes low-confidence in the semantic bundle; preserve them as attributed dated Jiang interpretation, not promoted fact.

The final baby-boomer passage points to the following source on Western decline; future gerontocracy work should keep this as a hinge from eschatological counterstrategy into intergenerational time-horizon failure.

canon_candidates.candidate: Jiang's 2025-08-01 10-20 year eschatological convergence scenario, split into separate comparison items for Iran/Hormuz, Odessa/NATO, Turkey/Byzantium, Israel/Third Temple, Putin succession, China absence, and Anglo-American retreat.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Do not promote as one broad apocalypse prediction. Compare each subclaim against later Prediction, Strategy, Chokepoint, Imperial Retrenchment, and Eschatology sources with source date, horizon, condition, and revision status separated.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is needed: the source is already central on Eschatology, Strategy, Secret Society, Iran, Gerontocracy, atlas, and glossary surfaces, with eight public lens-point anchors citing it.

If a future Eschatology compression pass happens, keep this source as the public definition spine and compress later AI, Pax Judaica, Al-Aqsa, Antichrist, and Gog-and-Magog material around it rather than creating topic pages from this source alone.

Before any Prediction ledger promotion, write a forecast-family comparison proposal that separates the Iran, Odessa, Turkey, Israel/Third Temple, Putin-succession, China-absence, and Anglo-American-retreat claims.

Do not create standalone Dugin, Third Rome, Catholic conspiracy, Holy Empire, Antichrist, Gog And Magog, Dome Of The Rock, World War III, or Baby Boomer Geopolitics pages from this source alone; route by active mechanism.
